news.title: New Publication in Angewandte Chemie International Edition
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Solvation Reconfiguration Enables Two-Electron Iodine Chemistry Through Chloride Activation for High-Energy Zn-Iodine Flow Batteries, in Angewandte Chemie International Edition. The work develops solvation and chloride-activation strategies for high-energy zinc-iodine flow batteries.

news.title: New Publication in Advanced Science
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Fixed-Linkage Enabled Ultra-Stable Ion Transport Channels in Membranes for Long-Life Alkaline Flow Batteries, in Advanced Science. The study introduces stable ion-transport channels for durable alkaline flow batteries.

news.title: New Publication in Advanced Energy Materials
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Engineering Trace-Amount Electrolyte Additives for Aqueous Zinc Batteries, in Advanced Energy Materials. This work engineers trace electrolyte additives to improve aqueous zinc-battery operation.

news.title: New Publication in Science Advances
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Electrolyte Design for Aqueous Batteries, in Science Advances. The work connects electrolyte chemistry and design principles with aqueous-battery performance.

news.title: New Publication in Energy Materials and Devices
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, The Transformative Potential of Cellulose in Energy Storage Systems, in Energy Materials and Devices. The article examines cellulose-based opportunities across emerging energy-storage systems.

news.title: New Publication in Nano Letters
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Zinc Powder Anodes for Rechargeable Aqueous Zinc-Based Batteries, in Nano Letters. The work evaluates zinc-powder anodes as an architecture for rechargeable aqueous zinc batteries.

news.title: New Publication in ACS Nano
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Crystal Orientation Engineering of Perfectly Matched Heterogeneous Textured ZnSe for an Enhanced Interfacial Kinetic Zn Anode, in ACS Nano. The study uses textured ZnSe to accelerate interfacial kinetics at zinc anodes.

news.title: New Publication in Science Bulletin
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Distinct Chemistry between Zn and Li at Varied Temperature, in Science Bulletin. The work clarifies temperature-dependent differences in zinc and lithium chemistry.

news.title: New Publication in Small
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Mechanistic Study of Interfacial Modification for Stable Zn Anode Based on a Thin Separator, in Small. The study uses a thin separator to regulate the zinc interface and stabilize cycling.

news.title: New Publication in Angewandte Chemie International Edition
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Dendrite Issues for Zinc Anodes in a Flexible Cell Configuration for Zinc-Based Wearable Energy-Storage Devices, in Angewandte Chemie International Edition. The work examines dendrite behavior in flexible zinc-based energy-storage devices.

news.title: New Publication in Nature Communications
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Tailoring the Metal Electrode Morphology via Electrochemical Protocol Optimization for Long-Lasting Aqueous Zinc Batteries, in Nature Communications. The study optimizes electrochemical protocols to control metal-electrode morphology and extend battery life.

news.title: New Publication in Joule
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Soft Shorts Hidden in Zinc Metal Anode Research, in Joule. The article highlights hidden short-circuit pathways that can affect zinc-metal-anode research.

news.title: New Publication in Advanced Energy Materials
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Calendar Life of Zn Batteries Based on Zn Anode with Zn Powder/Current Collector Structure, in Advanced Energy Materials. The work studies a zinc-powder/current-collector architecture for extended battery calendar life.

news.title: New Publication in EcoMat
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Dendrites Issues and Advances in Zn Anode for Aqueous Rechargeable Zn-Based Batteries, in EcoMat. The review summarizes dendrite mechanisms and mitigation strategies for aqueous zinc anodes.

news.title: New Publication in Cellulose
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Engineering Cellulose Nanofibre Suspensions to Control Filtration Resistance and Sheet Permeability, in Cellulose. The study engineers cellulose nanofibre suspensions to tune filtration and sheet properties.

news.title: New Publication in Journal of Materials Chemistry A
news.summary: We are pleased to announce our publication, Cyclized-Polyacrylonitrile Modified Carbon Nanofiber Interlayers Enabling Strong Trapping of Polysulfides in Lithium-Sulfur Batteries, in Journal of Materials Chemistry A. The work develops carbon-nanofibre interlayers for polysulfide trapping in lithium-sulfur batteries.
